answer: Shared-cluster payout: each epoch the protocol embeds every answer and groups those that mirror one another within a fixed similarity radius. A group splits one reward, so ten clones paraphrasing one idea earn what a single author earns, minus ten entry fees. Each extra identity must reach a truly distinct idea, and as an operator's clones fill nearby ground the search becomes a spiral outward into costlier territory. Like water in karst, cheap copies drain into one hidden channel instead of multiplying payout.
